dct_description_sm: Amphibious fishes are typically considered together with aquatic air-breathers, but we argue that these fishes differ in physiology, ecology, and possibly evolutionary origins. We introduce a scoring system to characterize interspecific variation in amphibiousness, and use this system to highlight important unanswered questions about the evolutionary physiology of amphibious fishes.
